paite: Huai lai in Baladan tapa Babulon kumpipa Merodak-baladan in Hezekiah kiang ah achi ana chih leh adam nawnta chih azak ziak in laite leh kipahman akhak hi.
heading: Babulon A Kipan A Palaite / (2 Kum 20.12-19)
english: At that time, Merodach Baladan the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah; for he heard that he had been sick, and had recovered.

paite: Huchi in Hezekiah atung uah akipak a, akiang uah athil manphate koihna inn dangkate, dangka-engte, gimlim bangbang hiamte, sathau manphate, agalvan koihna insung tengtengte, agou hoih lak a om tengtengte a-ensak hi. A-inn leh agamsung a om himhim Hezekiah in akiang ua a-etsak louh a-om kei hi.
english: Hezekiah was pleased with them, and showed them the house of his precious things, the silver, and the gold, the spices, and the precious oil, and all the house of his armor, and all that was found in his treasures. There was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah didn’t show them.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa Hezekiah kiang ah zawlnei Isai ahoh a, akiang ah, "Den a mite'n bang ahia agen uh? Koi a kipan in ahia na kiang a ahong uh?" achi hi. Hezekiah in, "Gam gamlapi a kipan, Babulon a kipan in, ka kiang a hong pai ahi uh,” achi hi.
english: Then Isaiah the prophet came to king Hezekiah, and asked him, “What did these men say? Where did they come from to you?” Hezekiah said, “They have come from a country far from me, even from Babylon.”

paite: Huchi in ama'n, "Na inn ah bangbang en ahi ua?" achi hi. Hezekiah in, "Ka insung a om tengteng a-en vek uh; ka gou hoihte ka etsak louh bangmah a-om kei," chi in adawng hi.
english: Then he asked, “What have they seen in your house?” Hezekiah answered, “They have seen all that is in my house. There is nothing among my treasures that I have not shown them.”

paite: Huchi in Isai in Hezekiah kiang ah, "Sepaihte' TOUPA thu thei in.
english: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, “Hear the word of Yahweh of Armies:

paite: Ngai in na insung a om tengteng leh tuni tan a na pipute'n akholkhawmte uh Babulon a paipih in a-om vek ding; bangmah nutsiat in a-om kei ding; huchibang nite ahong tung ding, TOUPA'N achi.
english: ‘Behold, the days are coming when all that is in your house, and that which your fathers have stored up until this day, will be carried to Babylon. Nothing will be left,’ says Yahweh.

paite: Huan na tapa, na gil a hong gah ding, na suan dingte ngei lak a mi, apaimangpih ding uh; amau Babulon kumpipa' inn ah michilgeh ding in a-om ding uh," achi hi.
english: ‘They will take away your sons who will issue from you, whom you shall father, and they will be eunuchs in the king of Babylon’s palace.’”

paite: Huchi in Hezekiah in, Isai kiang ah, "TOUPA thu na gen ahoih hi," achi hi. Amah mah in, "Ka damsung in lemna leh muanna a-om ding hi," achi lai hi.
english: Then Hezekiah said to Isaiah, “Yahweh’s word which you have spoken is good.” He said moreover, “For there will be peace and truth in my days.”
